purpose: Teach: 不謹慎/憤慨/貫通/弱体/降下/命中/至難/浴びせ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の不謹慎な発言には注意しろ
lines.en: I want you to be careful about staff making disrespectful remarks.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Slight pause before 'disrespectful.' Steady eye contact. The tone of someone setting expectations, not accusing. Clipped at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の憤慨には誠実に対応します
lines.en: Understood. We'll respond to customer complaints with sincerity.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly formal. Slight nod on 'sincerity.' Even pace. The dutiful confirmation of someone who takes the instruction seriously and is committing it to action.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場を貫通する大ヒット商品を作れ
lines.en: I need our company to create a breakout product that cuts through the market.
lines.style: Firm and commanding. Weight on 'breakout.' Slow, deliberate pace. The voice of ambition paired with high expectation. No room for doubt.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。組織が弱体化しないよう若手を育成します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure we develop our younger staff so the organization stays strong.
lines.style: Thoughtful commitment. Slight emphasis on 'develop.' Steady, reliable tone. The confidence of someone offering a concrete plan forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、価格を降下させない戦略を立てろ
lines.en: Make sure our strategy doesn't let prices drop.
lines.style: Sharp and clear. Slight snap on 'doesn't.' Controlled intensity. The instruction of someone protecting the company's position with precision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様のニーズに命中する商品を出します
lines.en: Understood. We'll release products that hit exactly what customers need.
lines.style: Assured and direct. Light emphasis on 'exactly.' Steady rhythm. The tone of someone offering a solution with confidence in its execution.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、至難の市場開拓に挑め
lines.en: I want you to tackle challenging new markets.
lines.style: Inspirational but grounded. Weight on 'challenging.' Slight breath before 'new markets.' The voice of someone pushing the team forward with clarity and belief.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員に罵声を浴びせる管理職は厳罰で対応します
lines.en: Understood. Any manager who verbally abuses staff will face strict disciplinary action.
lines.style: Quiet steel. Measured and serious. Slight pause before 'strict.' The tone shifts—suddenly personal, moral. Not just corporate policy, but conviction.
